page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number at top right; title and first epigram centred; a second heading and epigram below; a gathering signature at the foot right. No margin notes.

l.i: Nam vos id rogat ille Beza vester.
Sed sic perlegite, o boni sodales,
Figatis, potius, vel hinc, vel illinc,
Sed clamet licet usque, & usque, & usque,
Sit totus volo vester hic libellus,
Quum vester quoque sit poeta totus.

page.notes: The initial letters B and H are large decorative initials, joined to their words. The long-s glyph is printed as a f-like form in places; rendered as s. The symbol for "et" is printed as &, and the "usque" forms appear as Ꞩ-like abbreviations, transcribed as usque. Some ornaments and rules on the page are not text.
